_readme: Where Tell runs, as the home page lists it. `shipped: false` shows 'coming in Wave 3' and no snippet. External hrefs open the code in the repository.

items.name: GitHub Action
items.what: Checks every pull request that touches a .compact file. Findings appear in GitHub code scanning on the line that leaks; the build fails above the severity you choose.
items.snippet:
- uses: RohanGlitched/tell@v1
  with:
    path: contract
    fail-on: high

items.name: Command line
items.what: A readable report, JSON for scripts, SARIF for code scanning. Runs the compiler your pragma asks for.

items.name: Web scanner
items.what: Paste a contract or a public repository. Share a report as a link that carries the contract itself; nothing is stored.

items.name: README badge
items.what: Your repository's grade on its README, refreshed about once a day.

items.name: Pull-request review
items.what: The Action comments on the changed lines of each pull request with the finding, the bits it gives away and, where one passes, a verified patch as a suggestion you commit.
items.snippet:
- uses: RohanGlitched/tell@v1
  with:
    comment: true
    suggest-fixes: true
    comment-on: medium

items.name: VS Code
items.what: Leaking lines marked on open and save, with the bits and the fix on hover, a quick fix that shows Tell's patch, and the grade in the status bar.
items.snippet:
Problems: critical: choice() is hidden behind a persistentHash anyone can reverse (2 bits)
Status bar: Tell: F

items.name: MCP server
items.what: Agents that write Compact call tell_scan on what they wrote, tell_check_fix after each edit, and tell_explain_rule for the why. Runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere.
